comparison.objective: Align and click a mop frame’s swivelling socket onto its handle; candidate screens media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a swivel, coaxially insert a long handle, compress a spring button, and latch it versus bimanual pouring, screen tilting, and bridge-clearing agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Handle must insert and click with lug seated and button exposed, remain on the bench and still, and be released for 1 s. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no spill/contamination/damage, and supported release for 3 s. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: A single coaxial insertion-and-latch task is materially different from selective many-body passage through a screen.
